summary: Storing card numbers and CVV is wrong.

findings.message: Storing the CVV is forbidden by PCI DSS; use the processor's saved-card token instead.
findings.question: Can we use the payment processor's saved-card token instead?
findings.suggested_text: Save a processor card token (never the card number or CVV) so repeat payments are one click.

findings.question: Which currencies must an invoice support?
